rows.title: Exact plan-price match
rows.defect: a charge within a cent of the plan price is taken as that plan

rows.title: Cheaper-tier yearly saving
rows.test: the gap times 12 from the cited prices

rows.title: The trade-off is said
rows.defect: the trade-off is dropped from the text
rows.test: the ads trade-off is in the text

rows.title: The 10-month rule
rows.defect: the rule is off by one: 9 months qualifies
rows.test: 9 months in a row does not qualify

rows.title: In a row, no gap
rows.defect: distinct months are counted instead of a run

rows.title: Annual upfront and saving
rows.defect: the yearly price is not subtracted from 12 monthly charges
rows.test: Prime: $139 up front, $40.88 a year less

rows.title: Overlap needs both, active
rows.defect: a Walmart+ charge counts however long ago it stopped
rows.test: a lapsed Walmart+ does not count

rows.title: The phone plan is asked
rows.defect: the plan is guessed from the bill amount
rows.test: a $100 T-Mobile bill with no plan said is a question, not a finding

rows.title: Amex credit capped
rows.test: two bills earn one $10 monthly credit

rows.title: One cancel, one yes
rows.defect: the cancel hand-off needs no approval
rows.test: each paid service's cancel needs one approval

rows.title: The rotation starts off
rows.defect: the rotation toggle is offered already on

rows.title: Costco break-even boundary
rows.defect: the break-even itself is called an upgrade
rows.test: exactly at the break-even keeps Gold Star

rows.title: Subscribe and Save extra rate
rows.defect: the whole five-item rate is counted as extra

rows.title: Stale terms said
rows.defect: a stale term is cited as current
rows.test: a stale price says it may have changed
